 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Heardlearned counsel for the petitioner and leaned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is in custody since 31.03.2024in connection with Chamakhandi P.S. Case No. 135 of 2024, corresponding to G.R. Case No.501 of 2024, now pending in the court of the learned S.D.J.M., Chhatrapur, Ganjam for commission of the offences under Sections 420/468/294/506 of I.P.C.
4.
It is alleged that the petitioner took a sum of Rs.4,00,000/-(rupees four lakhs) from the informant in the year 2017 on the pretext of arranging a job for him in the Army.
He also furnished an appointment letter, which was found to be a fake.
5. Considering the allegations and the apparent delay in lodging of the F.I.R., I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail.

Let the petitioner be released on bail on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the Court below including the following conditions:-
(i) He shall deposit Rs.50,000/-(rupees fifty thousand) toward cash security.

Further,
the court below shall insist upon two local sureties for such amount as it may deem fit and proper.

(ii) He shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction without obtaining permission of the Vivekananda Dutta vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190491909/
1 court below.
